phase_prompt.prompt_block: A towering monolithic stone structure forged from obsidian‑infused titanium alloy, its surface etched with Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs that emit a faint, bio‑luminescent glow. The central crystalline core hums softly, surrounded by a lattice of translucent conduits, all rendered in photorealistic detail within a dim cavern, evoking a sense of ancient mysticism and industrial precision.
